name: Smith Machine Bent-Over Row
steps: Face the Smith bar and take an overhand grip slightly wider than your shoulders.
Release the hooks and hinge at your hips with knees slightly bent until the bar hangs below your shoulders.
Pull the bar smoothly upward toward your lower ribs by driving your elbows behind you and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower the bar slowly back to full arm extension while maintaining your hinged torso angle.
tips: Adjust your foot placement slightly forward or back so the fixed vertical bar path feels smooth without scraping your thighs.
Keep your lower back flat and resist jerking your torso upright as you row.
